locations.name: The Roosevelt Island Tramway
locations.factShort: The Roosevelt Island Tramway is an aerial tramway that crosses the East River in New York City, connecting Roosevelt Island to the Upper East Side of Manhattan.

locations.name: The Brooklyn Botanic Garden
locations.factShort: Brooklyn Botanic Garden is a botanical garden in the borough of Brooklyn in New York City. The botanical garden occupies 52 acres in central Brooklyn, close to Mount Prospect Park, Prospect Park, and the Brooklyn Museum.

locations.name: Orchard Beach
locations.factShort: Orchard Beach (sometimes called the Bronx Riviera) is the only public beach in the New York City borough of the Bronx. The 115-acre, 1.1-mile-long beach is part of Pelham Bay Park and is situated on the western end of Long Island Sound.

locations.name: The Chelsea Hotel
locations.factShort: The Hotel Chelsea (also known as the Chelsea Hotel and the Chelsea) is a hotel at 222 West 23rd Street in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City.

locations.name: The Queens Giant
locations.factShort: Alley Pond Park is the second-largest public park in Queens, New York City, occupying 655.3 acres. The park is bordered to the east by Douglaston, to the west by Bayside, to the north by Little Neck Bay, and to the south by Union Turnpike.
